verdict.native8_human_semantic_success: Not established; native correspondence remains UNKNOWN and exact mesh membership remains unnecessary.

precise_counterexamples.input: One RGB, q=(1,0), L8 and same targetbox, with two cue regions rA=(0,0) and rB=(2,0), both entirely FULL.
precise_counterexamples.why_unidentifiable: Permitted model inputs are identical; the private cue ID selects opposite labels. A grid cell/row index does not specify which reference the user requested. Native8 cannot be inferred from either AI cue ID.

precise_counterexamples.input: A crop contains a visible pallet cue and an opaque foreign object at another position.
precise_counterexamples.failure: A generic any-occluder or any-visible-pallet classifier may fit controlled examples while ignoring the intended reference. Unchanged reference siblings/nonanchor cues are needed as controls, but controls alone do not supply a missing identity token.

precise_counterexamples.input: One arbitrary annotated cue per RGB, with no exact repeated input conflict.
precise_counterexamples.failure: The model can memorize image/scene-to-teacher-cue association. Other visible cues are unannotated, so uniqueness of the annotation is not uniqueness of the inferable target.

input_provenance: Freeze grid from rawHW and/or an existing GT-free predicted box, input-only L rule, all rows/order/validity and any candidate policy before joining cue GT.
Preserve no-detection and wrong-instance proposal ledgers. Full-frame fallback/grid is a separately declared emulated proposal distribution; it is not deployed native8 initializer success.
No q recenter, L enlargement, candidate replacement, native reorder or class choice based on the cue/state/coverage.
label_provenance: Keep reference coordinate/uncertainty/operational description fixed and GT-only. Define the uncertainty to include localization AND the visual-cue extent before interventions; existing +/-4px is weak AI evidence, not calibrated gold.
Original visible-cue teacher is conditional AI annotation, not mask-positive certification or native8 gold.
A controlled covered teacher requires traceable distinct foreground RGB and exact opacity over the entire admitted cue support; partial/missing evidence is U.
Underlying referenceD/E and cropFULL/PARTIAL/MISS/invalid are distinct fields. Only FULL can contribute cue-target loss; miss/partial/unknown must not becomeE.
Other unannotated possible cues remain UNKNOWN, not negative examples.
Whole-mask0 is neither semanticE norS; a virtual native reference need not lie on exact physical mesh.
admissible_grid_and_label_contract.scalar_loss_admission: A scalar specific-reference label requires an operational association determined by deployment-available inputs, not a private teacher ID. Until that is supplied, use the generic evidence in a separately named spatial/paired auxiliary, not as native8 D/E labels.
admissible_grid_and_label_contract.auxiliary_option: Sparse spatial wooden-cue evidence: supervise the position/uncertainty of an observed original cue on D/neutral images and preserve known changed-region/disappearance evidence after coverage. Keep all unannotated locations unknown. Do not force the whole E image heatmap to zero; other cues can remain visible. This remains target/category-conditional weak evidence, not a proof of instance ownership.
auxiliary_cautions: Do not label every uncertainty-box pixel as a corner; it is a localization uncertainty set.

A foreign donor can contain its own similar structural cue. Either retain that ambiguity or predeclare a distinct non-pallet donor class; do not silently label generic visible-cue negatives when another eligible cue is present.
A targetbox mixed with multiple pallets does not determine target ownership. Class word pallet alone is not an instance/reference selector.
